scientific_integrity: Complete analytic proof for the stated parameter domain. Numeric checks are reproducibility aids, not certificates or independent review.
scientific_limitations: The high-intensity unequal-rate result is for fixed strictly different positive rates and is not uniform at equality.
No claim of original discovery of Poisson underdispersion, the Skellam identity, or identical-rate Fano limits.
Some potentially close prior results were available only in indexed summaries, so historical priority is provisional.
No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
title: Sharp variance-deficit crossover for unequal-rate Poisson maxima
